redirect_rules.D1_mcp_exempt: MCP endpoints dual-serve on subdomain AND canonical path. Never redirect.
redirect_rules.D3_one_hop: Every redirect lands directly on the canonical path. No chains.
redirect_rules.D6_canary: WELL is the canary. 15-min cadence × 72h. 0 unexpected 5xx → green → Phase 4b.
redirect_rules.D7_tombstones: Internal-only services return 410 Gone publicly. Tailscale mesh only.

navigation_rules.universal_frame: Every page must include: sovereign_strip · breadcrumb · page_content · prev_next_nav · mission_footer.

epistemic_registers.rule: F6 dual-register: kernel/audit surfaces emit MARUAH; UI chips/prose emit EMPATHY.

design_rules.red_rationed: ONLY three surfaces: sovereign strip, verdict chips (888/HOLD/VOID), seals. Red elsewhere = design VOID.
design_rules.amber_exception: AMBER (--amber-500 #D4A853) is reserved for the AAA cockpit bridge. ONLY non-primer exception.
design_rules.one_torus_per_page: Page renders at most one toroidal anchor (trinity_ring OR mission_wheel, never both).
design_rules.sovereign_bare: /arif background-image must be 'none'. No fractal on sovereign.
design_rules.single_skeleton: Only IBM Plex superfamily may be referenced in compiled CSS.
design_rules.self_hosted_only: No @import or font URL pointing to Google Fonts, fonts.com, etc.
